videos.overview: Action from the European championship's fifth day. In Group B, reigning champions Germany faced Italy in Preston, while France clashed with Norway in Warrington.

videos.title: 11th June 2005: Women's Euro 2005: England v Sweden
videos.overview: Coverage from Ewood Park, Blackburn, where the host nation play their final Group A game in the qualifying stages. Finland's clash against Denmark kicks off at the same time at Bloomfield Road, Blackpool.

videos.title: 13th June 2005: Women's Euro 2005
videos.overview: Highlights from Group B as defending champs Germany meet the French, while former winners Norway face Italy.

videos.title: 15th June 2005: Women's Euro 2005 Semi-Final
videos.overview: Germany v Finland at Deepdale, Preston.

videos.title: 16th June 2005: Women's Euro 2005 Semi-Final
videos.overview: Sweden v Norway at Warrington's Halliwell Jones Stadium.

videos.title: 19th June 2005: Women's Euro 2005 Final: Germany v Norway
videos.overview: The two teams that have battled through the group stages and semi-final showdowns meet at Ewood Park.

videos.title: 7th August 2005: Community Shield: Chelsea v Arsenal
videos.overview: This afternoon's traditional curtain-raiser to the new season saw Premiership champions Chelsea play FA Cup holders Arsenal at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff.

videos.title: 9th August 2005: Uefa Champions League Qualifier
videos.overview: Manchester United v Debreceni VSC. Coverage from Old Trafford of the first leg of United's third-round Champions League qualifier.

videos.title: 13th August 2005
videos.overview: The waiting is over: as the Premiership season gets under way, Gary Lineker presents highlights of today's eight games. While Goodison's prodigal son Wayne Rooney returns to Everton in Manchester United colours and European champions Liverpool travel to Middlesbrough, other action includes Sunderland's return to the top flight in a home game against Charlton, and play-off winners West Ham's clash with Blackburn.

videos.title: 17th August 2005: International Friendly
videos.overview: Highlights of England's friendly against Denmark in Copenhagen as Sven-Goran Eriksson 's men prepare for next month's crucial World Cup qualifiers away to Wales and Northern Ireland.

videos.title: 20th August 2005
videos.overview: New signing Edgar Davids makes his White Hart Lane Premiership debut as Spurs face Middlesbrough. Also Liverpool take on Sunderland, Blackburn Rovers are at home against Fulham, while Newcastle United host West Ham at St James' Park.

videos.title: 24th August 2005
videos.overview: Highlights of tonight's three Premiership matches as champions Chelsea welcome West Bromwich Albion to Stamford Bridge, Arsenal take on Fulham in a London derby at Highbury and Blackburn Rovers entertain Tottenham Hotspur.

videos.title: 27th August 2005
videos.overview: Were Spurs able to break a winless league streak against Chelsea dating back to 1990? Did Fulham preserve an unbeaten 39-year home record against Everton? All will be revealed in action from all seven of today's Premiership games.

videos.title: 7th September 2005: World Cup Qualifier
videos.overview: Northern Ireland v England. Sven's men travel to Windsor Park for a crucial World Cup qualifier, just days after clashing with Wales in Cardiff.

videos.title: 10th September 2005
videos.overview: Highlights of today's eight top-flight games, including the eagerly awaited Manchester derby, Liverpool's visit to Tottenham, and a clash of the champions as Premiership kings Chelsea welcome Championship winners Sunderland.

videos.title: 17th September 2005
videos.overview: Highlights of Charlton v Chelsea and Fulham v West Ham, plus Sunderland's clash with West Brom and Tottenham's trip to Aston Villa.

videos.title: 24th September 2005
videos.overview: Action from West Ham's London derby against Arsenal, plus Aston Villa's bid to get on the scoresheet against Chelsea after drawing a blank last season and Blackburn boss Mark Hughes 's return to Man United.

videos.title: 1st October 2005
videos.overview: Have Fulham beaten Manchester United at home for the first time in 41 years? Highlights of this plus all today's other Premiership matches, including Sunderland v West Ham, Charlton v Spurs and Blackburn v West Brom.

videos.title: 8th October 2005: World Cup Qualifier: Northern Ireland v Wales
videos.overview: Coverage from Windsor Park of this Group Six World Cup qualifier. The home side will be buoyant after their victory over England, while Wales will be hoping to salvage some pride and lift themselves from the foot of the table.

videos.title: 8th October 2005: World Cup Qualifier: England v Austria
videos.overview: After losing to Northern Ireland, England must win this World Cup qualifier against third-place Austria if they are to top Group Six.

videos.title: 12th October 2005: World Cup Qualifier: England v Poland
videos.overview: England's World Cup fate could hang in the balance at Old Trafford in Manchester as they face Poland in their final Group Six qualifier.

videos.title: 15th October 2005
videos.overview: Highlights of all seven of today's Premiership matches, which included Chelsea taking on Bolton, Wigan facing Newcastle in a league fixture for the first time and Liverpool hosting Blackburn.

videos.title: 22nd October 2005
videos.overview: Today's Premiership highlights saw Arsenal host Manchester City and Man Utd entertain Spurs, both home sides hoping to steal a march on rivals Chelsea who play Everton tomorrow.

videos.title: 29th October 2005
videos.overview: Premiership highlights, including the north London derby between Tottenham and Arsenal, plus Wigan at home to Fulham - the first meeting of the sides since their Division Two clash six years ago - and Man Utd away to Middlesbrough.

videos.title: 5th November 2005
videos.overview: Premiership highlights, including Aston Villa at home to European champions Liverpool, and newly promoted Sunderland's bid to win at Highbury - for the first time in 22 years. Plus the pick of today's FA Cup first-round ties.

videos.title: 6th November 2005: FA Cup First Round
videos.overview: Chasetown v Oldham Athletic. An FA Cup first-round tie against one-time semi-finalists gives the Staffordshire non-league side their biggest match to date

videos.title: 12th November 2005: International Friendly
videos.overview: Argentina v England. Old rivals lock horns again in Geneva, Switzerland, scene of this eagerly awaited friendly.

videos.title: 19th November 2005
videos.overview: Premiership highlights, including Chelsea v Newcastle, Charlton v Manchester United, Liverpool v Portsmouth, Wigan v Arsenal, Manchester City v Blackburn, and West Brom v Everton.

videos.title: 26th November 2005
videos.overview: Highlights of today's six Premiership ties, including dream-start debutants Wigan Athletic's clash with a reinvigorated Tottenham at the JJB Stadium, and Portsmouth's unenviable task of taking on Chelsea at Fratton Park.

videos.title: 3rd December 2005
videos.overview: Premiership highlights include Arsenal v Bolton and Chelsea v Middlesbrough.

videos.title: 4th December 2005: FA Cup Second Round
videos.overview: Worcester City v Huddersfield. The Conference North minnows take on the League One high-flyers in this tantalising FA Cup second-round tie. Following their 4-1 first-round win, the Terriers - who won the Cup once, way back in 1928 - should beat a side that last reached this stage in 1984. But their defeat by Accrington Stanley two years ago should give the underdogs hope.

videos.title: 10th December 2005
videos.overview: Chelsea's potentially fascinating game against overachieving new boys Wigan and Newcastle's clash with an Arsenal side they've found unbeatable of late are among the Premiership highlights mulled over by host Gary Lineker and the MOTD pundits.

videos.title: 17th December 2005
videos.overview: Premiership highlights, including Manchester Utd's clash with Aston Villa , Bolton's trip to Everton and the game between two of the season's early pace-setters, Wigan and Charlton.

videos.title: 26th December 2005
videos.overview: Ten Premiership ties took place today, including Charlton v Arsenal and Chelsea v Fulham. Plus all the goals from the other matches.

videos.title: 28th December 2005
videos.overview: The Merseyside derby between Everton and Liverpool is likely to have been the most hotly contested of today's games, but Chelsea had a point to prove against recent bugbears Manchester City, while title-chasers Arsenal and Manchester United needed points from Portsmouth and Birmingham respectively.

videos.title: 31st December 2005
videos.overview: Comprehensive Premiership highlights, including Chelsea v Birmingham, Manchester Utd v Bolton, Sunderland v Everton, and Portsmouth v Fulham.

videos.title: 2nd January 2006
videos.overview: The best of today's Premiership action, including Chelsea's tough-looking assignment at Upton Park against West Ham. Plus highlights of Blackburn's game against Portsmouth and Newcastle United's appointment with mid-table neighbours Middlesbrough.

videos.title: 7th January 2006: FA Cup Third Round: Hull City v Aston Villa
videos.overview: Championship side Hull will be looking to cause an upset against the seven-times winners of the competition, who have struggled to emulate their past glories of late, both in cup competitions and the Premiership.

videos.title: 7th January 2006: FA Cup Third Round: Luton Town v Liverpool
videos.overview: Kenilworth Road is the venue for two sides who, when they last met in the tournament back in 1987, needed two replays to separate them. These days, Championship contenders Luton are looking to return to the top flight of English football, while European champions Liverpool are beginning their bid to win a seventh FA Cup, spearheaded by manager Rafael Benitez and captain Steven Gerrard.

videos.title: 7th January 2006: FA Cup Third Round
videos.overview: Did dreams come true for the would-be giant killers? Mark Pougatch introduces action from today's FA Cup ties, in which Premiership and Championship sides entered the fray alongside football's minnows.

videos.title: 8th January 2006: FA Cup Third Round: Leicester City v Tottenham Hotspur
videos.overview: Spurs are eight-times winners of the competition and manager Martin Jol 's side are currently enjoying their best Premiership season for years. By contrast, Leicester have been struggling in the lower half of the Championship so will be particularly hopeful of victory tonight. Plus highlights of this afternoon's three other third-round ties, including the much-anticipated meeting of non-League Burton Albion and Manchester United.

videos.title: 14th January 2006
videos.overview: Action from - plus reaction to - eight Premiership fixtures, including the Manchester derby, Aston Villa v West Ham, Liverpool v Spurs, Blackburn v Bolton and Arsenal v Middlesbrough.

videos.title: 18th January 2006: FA Cup Third Round Replay
videos.overview: FA Cup Third-round Replay coverage of one of tonight's replays to decide who makes it through to the fourth round - even if it means the dreaded penalty shoot-out.

videos.title: 21st January 2006
videos.overview: Did Arsenal extend their seven-match unbeaten run away to Everton? Was there a fiery encounter at St James' Park, where Newcastle manager Graeme Souness encountered his old club Blackburn?

videos.title: 28th January 2006: FA Cup Fourth Round: Cheltenham Town v Newcastle United
videos.overview: It's the biggest day in the history of League Two Cheltenham Town as they take on six-time winners the Magpies in this FA Cup fourth-round tie. Tiny Whaddon Road has never before played host to top-flight opposition in the Cup, and John Ward's side will relish the chance to share a pitch with Alan Shearer and co. Despite a proud FA Cup tradition, Newcastle haven't won the trophy since 1955 and Shearer would love to lift it in his final season.

videos.title: 28th January 2006: FA Cup Fourth Round: Bolton Wanderers v Arsenal
videos.overview: Arsenal travel to the Reebok Stadium for what is likely to be a hard-fought FA Cup fourth-round fixture. A single goal was enough to give the Gunners a win here in last season's sixth-round tie, but the current holders know they won't be in for an easy ride after losing 2-0 to the Trotters in the Premiership earlier this year.

videos.title: 28th January 2006: FA Cup Fourth Round
videos.overview: Today's feast of FA Cup fourth-round football included the all-Premiership clash between Bolton Wanderers and holders Arsenal, and Cheltenham Town's giant-killing attempt against Graeme Souness' mighty Newcastle United.

videos.title: 29th January 2006: FA Cup Fourth Round: Portsmouth v Liverpool
videos.overview: This FA Cup fourth-round tie pits Harry Redknapp's Portsmouth against European champions Liverpool at Fratton Park. This could be close: two years ago Portsmouth beat Liverpool in a fifth-round replay - and, in 1992's semis, Liverpool required penalties to break Pompey hearts.

videos.title: 1st February 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of tonight's games, including Chelsea's trip to Aston Villa, where the Blues haven't won in the Premiership for almost seven years. Meanwhile Manchester United and Blackburn meet for the third time in a month following their Carling Cup semi-final, and relegation-threatened Birmingham face a tough task against Liverpool at Anfield.

videos.title: 4th February 2006
videos.overview: With Chelsea and Liverpool meeting tomorrow, today's focus was the bottom of the Premiership. Sunderland and Portsmouth faced West Ham and Newcastle respectively, Birmingham hosted Arsenal, and ex-Red Devils Bryan Robson and Mark Hughes locked horns as West Brom played Blackburn.

videos.title: 8th February 2006: FA Cup Fourth Round Replay
videos.overview: Coverage of one of tonight's replays to decide who makes it through to the fifth round - even if it means the dreaded penalty shoot-out.

videos.title: 11th February 2006
videos.overview: Chelsea take the defence of their Premiership title to Middlesbrough, Portsmouth play Manchester United, who have yet to score a Premiership goal at Fratton Park, and Bolton descend on Arsenal hoping for a repeat of December's 2-0 league win. Plus Liverpool v Wigan, Aston Villa v Newcastle, Everton v Blackburn and Fulham v West Brom.

videos.title: 18th February 2006: FA Cup Fifth Round: Liverpool v Manchester United
videos.overview: Passions will be running high at Anfield in an all-Premiership FA Cup fifth-round tie between two fierce rivals. As well as deciding a spot in the last eight, the match will also go some way to deciding bragging rights as the premier team in the North West. On past results in this competition, United hold the upper hand with eight wins to two in their favour. But Rafa Benftez's men will be pumped up following the 1-0 defeat at Old Trafford last month.

videos.title: 18th February 2006: FA Cup Fifth Round: Newcastle United v Southampton
videos.overview: Two sides in a state of flux meet for an intriguing FA Cup fifth-round tie at St James' Park. Both teams have experienced recent managerial upheaval: George Burley took over at the Saints following the departure of Harry Redknapp , while Graeme Souness left the Geordie giants after a huge financial outlay failed to bring returns on the pitch.

videos.title: 18th February 2006: FA Cup Fifth Round
videos.overview: FA Cup fifth-round action from the all-Premiership ties Liverpool v Manchester United, and Bolton v West Ham. Plus Newcastle United v Southampton and League One Brentford attempting to cause an upset away to Charlton.

videos.title: 19th February 2006: FA Cup Fifth Round: Aston Villa v Manchester City
videos.overview: Coverage of this all-Premiership FA Cup fifth-round tie from Villa Park. With the competition key to both clubs' hopes of qualifying for Europe, it promises to be a hard-fought encounter.

videos.title: 25th February 2006
videos.overview: Highlights from today's Premiership as the relegation battle hots up. How did struggling Birmingham fare against an equally troubled Sunderland? Did Chelsea pile on the misery for Portsmouth? And did Euro hopefuls Blackburn Rovers make trouble for Arsenal?

videos.title: 1st March 2006: International Friendly
videos.overview: England v Uruguay. Gary Lineker presents live coverage from Anfield, as England continue preparations for the World Cup finals with a friendly against Uruguay.

videos.title: 4th March 2006
videos.overview: Premiership highlights including West Bromwich v Chelsea and Newcastle v Bolton.

videos.title: 11th March 2006
videos.overview: Highlights from a potentially crucial day's football in the Premiership, including Chelsea v Tottenham, Birmingham City v West Bromwich Albion and Bolton Wanderers v West Ham United.

videos.title: 15th March 2006: FA Cup 5th Round Replay
videos.overview: West Ham United v Bolton Wanderers. Two Premiership high-flyers seek to further their European ambitions as they vie for an FA Cup quarter-final place at the Boleyn Ground.

videos.title: 18th March 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of all today's Premiership games, including Arsenal v Charlton.

videos.title: 20th March 2006: FA Cup 6th Round
videos.overview: Manchester City v West Ham. Coverage of the first FA Cup quarter-final tie.

videos.title: 22nd March 2006: FA Cup 6th Round
videos.overview: Chelsea v Newcastle United. In what should turn out to be the tie of the FA Cup quarter-final matches, the Premiership champions take on the resurgent Magpies.

videos.title: 23rd March 2006: FA Cup 6th Round
videos.overview: Charlton v Middlesbrough. Coverage of the last of this week's all-Premiership FA Cup quarter-finals as Charlton welcome Middlesbrough to the Valley.

videos.title: 25th March 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of all today's Premiership games, including Liverpool v Everton, Chelsea v Manchester City and Portsmouth v Arsenal.

videos.title: 25th March 2006: Women's World Cup Qualifier
videos.overview: England v France. Coverage from Ewood Park of this Women's World Cup qualifying game. Can Hope Powell 's England even the score following their defeat by France in the 2003 qualifiers

videos.title: 1st April 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of all today's Premiership games, including Arsenal v Aston Villa, Bolton v Manchester United and Newcastle v Tottenham.

videos.title: 8th April 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of today's Premiership games. Relegation-threatened Birmingham travelled to Wigan and fellow strugglers Portsmouth hosted Blackburn, who've been chasing a place in Europe. Tottenham, another side aiming for at least a Uefa Cup berth, are at home to Manchester City, while Charlton welcomed Everton and Fulham headed to Sunderland.

videos.title: 12th April 2006: FA Cup Sixth Round Replay
videos.overview: Middlesbrough v Charlton Athletic. The two teams reconvene for this FA Cup quarter-final replay at the Riverside Stadium after a goalless draw at the Valley last month.

videos.title: 15th April 2006
videos.overview: A packed Premiership weekend continued today with Bolton taking on Chelsea and Fulham playing Charlton, while relegation-threatened West Brom faced a tough trip to Arsenal as Portsmouth entertained Middlesbrough.

videos.title: 17th April 2006
videos.overview: Action from today's seven Premiership games. A Spurs side chasing a place in Europe next year sought a rare result against visitors Manchester United. Meanwhile, relegation certainties Sunderland aimed to salvage some pride at home against North East rivals Newcastle, while Portsmouth and West Brom continued their campaigns to stay up with tricky ties against Charlton and Bolton respectively.

videos.title: 22nd April 2006: FA Cup Semi-Final
videos.overview: Chelsea v Liverpool. Gary Lineker presents one of the year's biggest games as the Premiership champions take on the European champions at Old Trafford for a place in the FA Cup final on 13 May.

videos.title: 22nd April 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of today's five Premiership matches and the FA Cup semi-final between Chelsea and Liverpool.

videos.title: 29th April 2006
videos.overview: Chelsea v Manchester United was today's stand-out Premiership match. Plus, could Portsmouth repeat their great escape of 2004, away to Wigan, and Blackburn Rovers secure a Champions League place on a visit to Charlton?

videos.title: 1st May 2006: Women's FA Cup Final: Leeds United v Arsenal
videos.overview: Coverage from the New Den, Millwall, of a north v south showpiece clash. Arsenal are seeking their third league-and-cup double in the past six seasons. By contrast, this is Leeds' first appearance in the final. But the Yorkshire side come into the clash with their confidence buoyed by a convincing semi-final win over Liverpool.

videos.title: 7th May 2006
videos.overview: Highlights of the final Premiership ties of the season. As champions Chelsea enjoy their trip to Newcastle, stragglers Birmingham, West Brom and Portsmouth face Bolton, Everton and Liverpool respectively, in potentially critical games.

videos.title: 11th May 2006: Women's World Cup Qualifier
videos.overview: England v Hungary. Coverage from St Mary's, Southampton, of the Women's World Cup qualifier. With only the group winners going through to next year's finals in China, England cannot afford any slip-ups but they'll be hot favourites to win this evening, having beaten Hungary 13-0 in Budapest in October.

videos.title: 13th May 2006: FA Cup Final: Liverpool v West Ham United
videos.overview: All the magic of the Cup is about to envelop the two Premiership sides who line up this afternoon for the 125th annual showpiece occasion at Cardiff's Millennium Stadium. The Merseysiders, favourites for a seventh Cup win, have a slight psychological advantage, having recently beaten their opponents in the league when Luis Garcia and Hayden Mullins were sent off. Three-time winners West Ham are through to their first final since 1980, but they know how to win in Cardiff - 12 months ago they clinched promotion in the Championship play-off final.

videos.title: 27th May 2006: International Friendly
videos.overview: Trinidad and Tobago v Wales. England's World Cup Group B opponents Trinidad and Tobago take on Wales in a warm-up game at the Liebherr GAK Stadium in Graz, Austria.

videos.title: 30th May 2006: International Friendly
videos.overview: England v Hungary. Coverage of this international friendly at Old Trafford, with just 11 days to go until England's World Cup campaign gets under way in Frankfurt.

videos.title: 3rd June 2006: International Friendly
videos.overview: England's first ever match against Jamaica in this friendly at Old Trafford.

videos.title: 9th June 2006: World Cup 2006: Germany v Costa Rica
videos.overview: Hosts Germany take on Costa Rica in the opening game of the tournament.

videos.title: 9th June 2006: World Cup 2006
videos.overview: Highlights from the opening day of the tournament, which saw hosts Germany take on Costa Rica, while Poland faced Ecuador.

videos.title: 10th June 2006: World Cup 2006: England v Paraguay
videos.overview: England's World Cup campaign starts here, in Frankfurt and fans will be expecting a victory. Paraguay are no pushovers, though - the South Americans beat Argentina on their way to qualifying for this, their third successive World Cup finals.

videos.title: 10th June 2006: World Cup 2006
videos.overview: Highlights from all of day two's games, with Adrian Chiles , Gordon Strachan and Lee Dixon.

videos.title: 11th June 2006: World Cup 2006: Serbia and Montenegro v Netherlands

videos.title: 25th April 2015

videos.title: 2nd May 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights from all of the day's Premier League matches, including Liverpool v QPR and Manchester United v West Brom.

videos.title: 9th May 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights of seven Premier League matches including Manchester United's trip to Crystal Palace and the relegation showdown between Hull and Burnley.

videos.title: 16th May 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the day's seven Premier League matches in the penultimate week of the season.

videos.title: 24th May 2015
videos.overview: Highlights from the final day of the 2014-15 Premier League season, presented by Gary Lineker. Hull City play Manchester United at the KC Stadium and Newcastle host West Ham at St James' Park. At kick-off, Hull sit in the final relegation position making it a must-win game for them. If Steve Bruce finally chalks up his first victory against Manchester United in 17 years of management, Hull will still need to hope that Newcastle drop points against the Hammers in order to survive. All eyes are on Steven Gerrard in Liverpool's match at Stoke, with the Reds captain set to play his final game for the club before departing to join Los Angeles Galaxy. In London, Chelsea play Sunderland, Arsenal take on West Brom and Crystal Palace meet Swansea. Elsewhere, Tottenham travel to Everton, Manchester City face Southampton, Leicester City host Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa meet Burnley.

videos.title: 2nd August 2015: Community Shield: Chelsea v Arsenal
videos.overview: Highlights of the season's traditional curtain-raiser at Wembley Stadium, which sees Premier League champions Chelsea take on FA Cup winners Arsenal. The match will be the first between the clubs since long-serving Blues goalkeeper Petr Cech was allowed to move across the capital to join the Gunners, although it remains to be seen whether the 33-year-old makes his debut against his former employers. Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger may see this match as an opportunity to rid himself of an unwanted statistic - he is winless in 13 matches against Chelsea boss Jose Mourinho. Wenger's men have failed to score a single goal in their last five games against the Blues, but they will have fond memories of their last trip to Wembley in May, when they thrashed Aston Villa 4-0 to win the FA Cup.

videos.title: 8th August 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces the best of the action and reaction from the opening day of the Premier League season. Chelsea began their title defence at home to Swansea, who had not won this fixture for 90 years, while an expensively revamped Manchester United side hosted Tottenham. The three promoted sides were all in action: Bournemouth made their top-flight debut against Aston Villa, Norwich welcomed Crystal Palace to Carrow Road, and Watford travelled to Everton.

videos.title: 15th August 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces Premier League highlights and reaction with studio guests Ian Wright and Jermaine Jenas. Tottenham host Stoke, looking to avenge back-to-back defeats last season. West Ham begin their final Premier League season at Upton Park with the visit of Leicester, while Swansea entertain Newcastle, boasting a six-game unbeaten run against them. The day's other fixtures see Southampton play Everton, Norwich travel to Sunderland and Watford face West Bromwich Albion. Plus highlights of Manchester United's trip to Aston Villa on Friday night.

videos.title: 22nd August 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's six Premier League matches. In the lunchtime kick-off, Manchester United welcomed Newcastle to Old Trafford, while West Ham entertained Bournemouth at Upton Park. Former West Ham manager Sam Allardyce is a guest in the studio alongside Alan Shearer. In the day's other games, Crystal Palace host Aston Villa, Tottenham travel to take on Leicester, Norwich play Stoke and Sunderland meet Swansea.

videos.title: 29th August 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's Premier League games, which include Newcastle's match against Arsenal. The Gunners ended last season strongly, lifting the FA Cup at Wembley after thrashing Aston Villa, but a poor start to their league campaign prevented them from challenging for the league title. Arsene Wenger's men have won their last seven games against Newcastle, and will be hopeful of extending that winning run at St James' Park. Elsewhere, reigning champions Chelsea face fellow Londoners Crystal Palace, while Aston Villa meet Sunderland, Bournemouth host Leicester and West Ham travel to Liverpool. Newly promoted Watford face a tough trip to Manchester City, while Stoke play West Brom and Tottenham face Everton. Analysis comes from Ruud Gullit and Martin Keown.

videos.title: 12th September 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's seven Premier League games with guests Alan Shearer and Ian Wright. Games include a mouth-watering clash between rivals Manchester United and Liverpool at Old Trafford. United completed the double over Brendan Rodgers' side last season and have only lost one of their last seven league games at home to Liverpool, but the visitors will be desperate to avenge their 3-0 defeat there in the previous campaign. Meanwhile, Everton take on reigning champions Chelsea at Goodison Park, which played host to a remarkable game between these sides last season - Jose Mourinho's side eventually winning 6-3. Elsewhere, Arsenal host Stoke, Manchester City travel to Crystal Palace and West Brom are home to Southampton. There's a clash of the newly-promoted teams as Norwich face Bournemouth, while Swansea are away to Watford.

videos.title: 19th September 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's seven Premier League matches, with studio guests Alan Shearer and Danny Murphy. Champions Chelsea entertain Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, the second meeting between the clubs this season following the Gunners' victory in the Community Shield in August. That win was Arsene Wenger's first in 14 attempts over his old adversary Jose Mourinho across an 11-year period. The day's other fixtures see Manchester City host West Ham, Roberto Martinez take his Everton side to former employees Swansea, Aston Villa play West Midlands neighbours West Bromwich Albion, Newcastle face Watford, Bournemouth take on Sunderland and Stoke meet Leicester.

videos.title: 26th September 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's eight Premier League matches. In the lunchtime kick-off Tottenham host Manchester City at White Hart Lane, with both clubs having had contrasting starts to the season. The day's other fixtures see Leicester take on Arsenal, Liverpool play Aston Villa, Manchester United face Sunderland, Southampton against Swansea, Stoke versus promoted Bournemouth, West Ham hosting Norwich and champions Chelsea travelling to Newcastle.

videos.title: 3rd October 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's seven Premier League matches, with Alan Shearer and Jermaine Jenas in the studio. Manchester City were looking to continue their strong start to the season against Newcastle. City had dominated the recent league meetings between these sides, scoring 17 unanswered goals en route to five consecutive victories. The day's other games saw former Crystal Palace manager Tony Pulis return to Selhurst Park with his current side West Brom, while Chelsea welcomed Southampton to Stamford Bridge. Elsewhere, Aston Villa hosted Stoke, Leicester travelled to Norwich, Sunderland entertained West Ham and Premier League new boys Bournemouth and Watford met on the south coast.

videos.title: 17th October 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces the best of the action and reaction from the day's eight Premier League matches. They include Tottenham's attempt to end a five-match losing streak against Liverpool, Everton's bid for a fourth consecutive victory over Manchester United at Goodison Park, and home games for Chelsea and Manchester City against Aston Villa and Bournemouth respectively. The day's other games feature Crystal Palace v West Ham, Southampton v Leicester, Watford v Arsenal and West Brom v Sunderland.

videos.title: 24th October 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's six Premier League matches with Ian Wright and Danny Murphy. Champions Chelsea faced a London derby away to West Ham with Jose Mourinho looking to preserve a proud record of never having lost to the Hammers in nine league and cup matches. Everton travelled to Arsenal hoping to end an 18-game losing streak that dates back to 1997. The day's other games saw early season high-fliers Leicester host Crystal Palace, Aston Villa entertain Swansea, Norwich play West Brom and Stoke against Watford.

videos.title: 31st October 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the day's seven Premier League matches. Chelsea met Liverpool in the early kick-off at Stamford Bridge, with both sides looking to recover from shaky starts to the season. Manchester United travelled to Crystal Palace, while Manchester City hosted Norwich and Arsenal made the trip down the M4 to face Swansea. The other fixtures saw struggling Newcastle face Stoke, Watford up against West Ham and West Brom were at home to Leicester.

videos.title: 7th November 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's Premier League games, which include Chelsea's trip to play Stoke at the Britannia Stadium. The Blues' hopes of successfully defending their Premier League title have been jeopardised by a poor start to the season, and Jose Mourinho's men cannot afford to drop more points against the Potters. Manchester United host a West Bromwich Albion side who are chasing a third consecutive win at Old Trafford, while West Ham boss Slaven Bilic faces one of his former sides as the Hammers take on Everton. Elsewhere, Bournemouth meet Newcastle, Leicester host Watford, Norwich take on Swansea and Sunderland face Southampton.

videos.title: 8th November 2015
videos.overview: Highlights from the FA Cup first round. Non-league sides that have battled through the preliminary rounds will be looking to extend their cup runs and make a name for themselves, while the 48 League One and Two clubs that enter at this stage will be aiming to avoid any embarrassing slip-ups while harbouring their own dreams of cup glory. Last season, Warrington Town and Worcester City made the headlines at this stage with wins against Exeter City and Coventry City.

videos.title: 14th November 2015: David Beckham's All Star Match for Children
videos.overview: Highlights of Unicef's Match for Children from Old Trafford. David Beckham captains a Great Britain and Ireland XI against an all-star Rest of the World team led by retired Portugal international Luís Figo to raise money for the children's charity. Beckham is reunited with his former Manchester United boss Sir Alex Ferguson, who returns to the dugout where he spent 26 years as manager. Beckham and Figo are joined by some of football's biggest names, while former Real Madrid and Chelsea manager Carlo Ancelotti takes charge of the World XI.

videos.title: 21st November 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's eight Premier League games, including Liverpool's trip to Manchester City. Raheem Sterling could line up against his former club - City made him the most expensive English player ever when they signed him over the summer, but it was a controversial move and angered some sections of Liverpool support. Elsewhere, Manchester United face a tricky lunchtime test at Watford, who have made a solid start to life back in the Premier League. In the day's other matches, Chelsea play Norwich, Everton take on Aston Villa, Newcastle host Leicester, Stoke travel to Southampton, Swansea welcome Bournemouth and West Brom are in action against Arsenal.

videos.title: 28th November 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's six Premier League games, including early-season pacesetters Manchester City taking on Southampton. City brought the curtain down on their Premier League season with a 2-0 home victory over Saints last season - consolidating their second-place finish behind Chelsea. Elsewhere, former Newcastle United manager Alan Pardew takes on the Magpies with his current club Crystal Palace. Pardew swapped St James' Park for Selhurst Park earlier this year and will want to continue his impressive start to the season with Palace. The day's other fixtures see another of the season's surprise packages, Leicester City, take on Manchester United. Elsewhere, Sunderland entertain Stoke, Everton travel to Bournemouth and Aston Villa face Watford.

videos.title: 5th December 2015
videos.overview: Highlights including Man United v West Ham, Chelsea v Bournemouth and Stoke v Man City.

videos.title: 12th December 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights of today's six Premier League matches, including the game between Bournemouth and Manchester United. The Cherries recorded one of the most famous results in their history when they beat United in the FA Cup in 1984, but this will be the first league clash between the clubs. The home side have struggled since winning promotion to the top flight last season, although they have been unfortunate with injuries, so manager Eddie Howe will hope for a change of luck against the Red Devils. Elsewhere, title hopefuls Manchester City host Swansea, relegation-threatened Sunderland meet Watford and West Ham take on Stoke, while Crystal Palace play Southampton and Everton visit Norwich.

videos.title: 19th December 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents all the highlights from the day's Premier League matches. Manchester United have beaten Norwich 4-0 the last three times the Canaries have visited Old Trafford so Louis van Gaal will be expecting three points again. Leicester are looking to continue their fine start to the season at Everton, while Tottenham travel to the south coast to face Southampton. Chelsea have endured a tough start to the defence of their title but would be expecting to overcome struggling Sunderland at Stamford Bridge. Newcastle and Aston Villa meet on Tyneside in what could be a crucial game in the relegation battle. The day's other games see Stoke host Crystal Palace and Bournemouth travel to West Brom.

videos.title: 26th December 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to a full programme of festive Premier League fixtures. Faltering champions Chelsea welcomed Watford to Stamford Bridge for their final home league fixture of 2015. Manchester City entertained bogey team Sunderland, a side they have beaten only four times in their last 11 league encounters. Stoke took on Manchester United at the Britannia Stadium looking to maintain an unbeaten home record against the Red Devils since ex-United player Mark Hughes became the Potters' manager. Elsewhere, Arsenal travelled to Southampton, Liverpool took on Leicester, Tottenham were up against Norwich, West Ham visited Aston Villa, Newcastle played Everton, Bournemouth hosted Crystal Palace and Swansea were in action against West Brom.

videos.title: 28th December 2015
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's eight Premier League matches as the busy festive period continues. Champions Chelsea travelled to Manchester United looking to continue an eight-game unbeaten run against the Red Devils in all competitions. The Blues were last beaten by United in October 2012. Arsenal entertained Bournemouth in the first ever league meeting between the clubs, whilst Tottenham were at Vicarage Road to take on Watford. The day's other matches saw West Ham take on Southampton, Norwich up against Aston Villa, Swansea travel to Crystal Palace, Everton face Stoke and West Brom play Newcastle.

videos.title: 2nd January 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights from the first Premier League matches of 2016. Liverpool lost 3-0 at home to West Ham earlier in the season and will be hoping to turn the tables on the Hammers in the return fixture. Swansea travel to Old Trafford looking to record their fourth successive league win over Manchester United. Title-chasers Manchester City make their first trip to Vicarage Road since 2007, while Arsenal aim for their ninth league victory in a row over Newcastle when the teams meet at the Emirates. Elsewhere, surprise package Leicester host Bournemouth, Sunderland face fellow strugglers Aston Villa, West Brom are at home to Stoke and Southampton travel to Norwich.

videos.title: 9th January 2016: FA Cup Third Round
videos.overview: Third Round Highlights - Saturday matches. Highlights from the day's FA Cup third-round matches. The Premier League and Championship clubs make their bow in this season's competition.

videos.title: 10th January 2016: FA Cup Third Round
videos.overview: Highlights from the weekend's FA Cup third round matches. Tottenham face Leicester City, Chelsea play Scunthorpe United and Swansea travel to Oxford United.

videos.title: 13th January 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces the best of the action and reaction from the week's ten Premier League matches, including a mouthwatering clash between Liverpool and Arsenal at Anfield and a meeting of two of the Premier League's early-season form sides Tottenham and Leicester City.

videos.title: 16th January 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces the best of the action from the day's seven Premier League matches. Manchester City and Chelsea are seeking to extend long unbeaten home runs against Crystal Palace and Everton respectively, while Leicester City, the season's surprise high-flyers, visit relegation-threatened Aston Villa. In the day's other games, Tottenham host Sunderland, Bournemouth welcome Norwich, West Ham visit Newcastle and Southampton take on West Brom.

videos.title: 23rd January 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's eight Premier League games, including the late kick-off at Upton Park where West Ham take on Manchester City. The Hammers produced an upset by winning at the Etihad Stadium in September's reverse fixture, and the east London side have also claimed eye-catching victories against Chelsea, Arsenal and Liverpool this season. Elsewhere, there is a London derby at Selhurst Park between Crystal Palace and Tottenham, and struggling Aston Villa go in search of a much-needed win as they travel to near neighbours West Brom.

videos.title: 30th January 2016: FA Cup Fourth Round
videos.overview: Gabby Logan presents highlights of the latest FA Cup fourth-round ties, including Arsenal v Burnley at the Emirates Stadium and Nottingham Forest v Watford at the City Ground and Portsmouth v Bournemouth at Fratton Park. The Gunners continued their bid to lift the trophy for the third season in a row, while fellow Premier League sides Watford and Bournemouth faced potentially tricky away ties.

videos.title: 31st January 2016: FA Cup Fourth Round
videos.overview: Highlights of the day's fourth-round FA Cup ties. Lower-league clubs left in the competition will be hoping to make a name for themselves against Premier League opposition.

videos.title: 2nd February 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of Tuesday's eight fixtures in the Premier League. Title-chasing Leicester host Liverpool at the King Power Stadium, hoping to avenge the 1-0 defeat they suffered at Anfield on Boxing Day. Another club looking for retribution is Arsenal, who were on the end of a surprise 4-0 thrashing at the hands of Southampton at Christmas. Elsewhere, struggling Sunderland face Manchester City, Tottenham travel to Norwich, West Ham host Aston Villa, Crystal Palace play Bournemouth, Manchester United welcome Stoke and West Brom take on Swansea.

videos.title: 6th February 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the day's seven Premier League matches, including an intriguing clash between Manchester City and Leicester City at the Etihad. Everton are out for revenge at the Britannia Stadium - Stoke beat them 4-3 in a thrilling encounter over Christmas - while Sunderland are on the hunt for points at Anfield. Aston Villa take on Norwich in a match they surely must win if they are to stand a chance of escaping relegation this season. Elsewhere, West Brom travel to Newcastle, Swansea host Crystal Palace and Tottenham meet Watford at White Hart Lane.

videos.title: 13th February 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's seven Premier League matches. Sunderland welcome Manchester United to the Stadium of Light looking to improve on a record that has seen the Black Cats win only two of their last 26 games against the Red Devils in all competitions. Early season strugglers Chelsea meet Newcastle at Stamford Bridge. The two sides played out an entertaining 2-2 at St. James' Park earlier in the season with the visitors scoring twice in the last 11 minutes to rescue a point. The day's other matches see Bournemouth play Stoke, Crystal Palace entertain Watford, Everton face West Brom, West Ham travel to Norwich and Swansea meet Southampton.

videos.title: 20th February 2016: FA Cup Fifth Round
videos.overview: Dan Walker introduces highlights from Saturday's fifth-round FA Cup ties, featuring Arsenal v Hull, Reading v West Brom, Watford v Leeds and Bournemouth v Everton.

videos.title: 21st February 2016: FA Cup Fifth Round
videos.overview: Highlights from Sunday's fifth-round FA Cup ties, featuring Blackburn v West Ham, Tottenham v Crystal Palace and Chelsea v Man City.

videos.title: 22nd February 2016: FA Cup Fifth Round
videos.overview: Highlights from the FA Cup as Manchester United make the trip to League One Shrewsbury in the fifth round of the competition. It will be the first ever meeting between the clubs.

videos.title: 27th February 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the day's six Premier League matches. High-flying Leicester City's home clash against Norwich City was one of the standout fixtures. The Foxes have been this season's surprise Premier League package and they look to continue their remarkable form against the Canaries at the King Power Stadium. In the lunchtime game, Sam Allardyce returned to his former employers West Ham. Allardyce left Upton Park last summer and, with new club Sunderland in relegation trouble, revenge would have tasted all the sweeter at his old stomping ground. Elsewhere, Chelsea travelled to Southampton, Stoke took on struggling Aston Villa, Watford faced Bournemouth at Vicarage Road and West Brom entertained Crystal Palace.

videos.title: 2nd March 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction to the week's full programme of midweek Premier League fixtures. With the race for the Premier League title heating up, there were some crucial games at the top of the table. Manchester City's trip to Anfield to take on Liverpool demanded top billing with City having lost 4-1 on home soil in November's corresponding fixture. West Ham and Tottenham met at Upton Park in another crucial game at the top of the table, while title contenders Leicester City and Arsenal had home matches against West Brom and Swansea respectively. At the bottom of the table, struggling Aston Villa took on Everton, Newcastle travelled to Stoke and Sunderland welcomed Crystal Palace to the Stadium of Light.

videos.title: 5th March 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker introduces the best of the action and reaction from the day's eight Premier League fixtures. Title rivals Tottenham and Arsenal met in the north London derby in the early kick-off, while Leicester City and Manchester City were seeking to further their championship hopes when they faced Watford and Aston Villa respectively.

videos.title: 12th March 2016
videos.overview: Highlights of the day's Premier League action, which includes the game between Stoke City and Southampton at the Britannia Stadium. The Potters won 1-0 when the sides met on the south coast in November and will be chasing a third successive win against the Saints. The lunchtime kick-off sees title Manchester City travel to relegation-threatened Norwich City, while Bournemouth meet Swansea.

videos.title: 19th March 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of Saturday's six Premier League matches. In the day's early kick-off, title-chasing Arsenal travel to Goodison Park to take on Everton. The Gunners are confident of victory, having lost just once to the Toffees in their last 18 encounters. Elsewhere, leaders Leicester travel to take on Crystal Palace, Chelsea play West Ham, Watford take on Stoke, West Brom face Norwich and Swansea are in action against Aston Villa.

videos.title: 2nd April 2016
videos.overview: Dan Walker presents highlights of Saturday's Premier League matches. Tottenham travel to Liverpool, while north London rivals Arsenal host Watford.

videos.title: 9th April 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of Saturday's Premier League matches, whose results affect both the title race and the relegation battle. Arsenal face one of this season's surprise packages West Ham in the early kick-off, with both sides needing three points to aid their aspirations at the top of the table. Manchester City have similar motivations in the evening kick-off when they host West Brom. In the afternoon kick-offs, all eyes are on the bottom of the table. Newcastle, under new manager Rafa Benitez, travel to Southampton while Norwich make the trip to south-east London to take on Crystal Palace. Elsewhere, Aston Villa entertain Bournemouth, Swansea welcome Chelsea and Everton travel to Vicarage Road to face Watford.

videos.title: 16th April 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents all the highlights from today's six Premier League matches including the relegation battle between Sunderland and Norwich, which could go a long way towards deciding which team avoids the drop. Elsewhere, Newcastle look to boost their own survival prospects against Swansea whilst Manchester City travel to Stamford Bridge to face last season's champions Chelsea. Manchester United play Aston Villa, Everton entertain Southampton and West Brom play Watford

videos.title: 23rd April 2016
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces the best of the action and reaction from the day's Premier League fixtures, including Liverpool at home to Newcastle, Bournemouth against Chelsea and Aston Villa versus Southampton.

videos.title: 24th April 2016: FA Cup Semi-Final
videos.overview: Action and reaction from the FA Cup semi-final at Wembley between Crystal Palace and Watford, introduced by Eilidh Barbour with commentary by Simon Brotherton and Martin Keown.

videos.title: 30th April 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of today's six Premier League games, including the clash between Newcastle United and Crystal Palace at St James' Park. Palace manager Alan Pardew faces his former club, who are desperate for points in their battle against relegation. The home side are out for revenge against Palace, who thrashed them 5-1 when the sides met at Selhurst Park in November. Sunderland are also hoping to boost their survival hopes as they travel to Stoke, while Norwich face a difficult game away to Arsenal. Elsewhere, Everton host Bournemouth, Watford take on Aston Villa and West Brom meet West Ham.

videos.title: 2nd May 2016
videos.overview: Dan Walker presents highlights of the Premier League match between Chelsea and Tottenham.

videos.title: 7th May 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the penultimate weekend of Premier League action, with eight matches taking place. Leicester have been the story of the season in the top flight, and they play their final home game of the campaign against an Everton side who have failed to live up to their own expectations. Meanwhile, Norwich host Manchester United in the lunchtime kick-off, Aston Villa and Newcastle meet at Villa Park, and Sunderland entertain Chelsea. Elsewhere, Watford travel to Liverpool, West Ham meet Swansea, West Brom are away to Bournemouth and Crystal Palace host Stoke.

videos.title: 15th May 2016
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights from all ten matches on the final day of a Premier League season that has been one of the most memorable in the competition's history. Champions Leicester travel to Chelsea, Tottenham are away to Newcastle, Arsenal take on Aston Villa, Everton play Norwich, Manchester United face Bournemouth, Southampton host Crystal Palace, Stoke welcome West Ham, Swansea play Manchester City, Watford face Sunderland and West Brom are at home to Liverpool.

videos.title: 21st May 2016: FA Cup Final: Manchester United v Crystal Palace
videos.overview: Highlights of the 2016 FA Cup final between Manchester United and Crystal Palace at Wembley Stadium.

videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of the opening game of Euro 2016.

videos.title: 11th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 2
videos.overview: Gary Lineker presents highlights of day two matches at Euro 2016 in France.

videos.title: 12th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 3
videos.overview: Jacqui Oatley presents highlights of the day's Euro 2016 action. Northern Ireland make their tournament bow against Poland, Germany face Ukraine, while Turkey take on Croatia.

videos.title: 13th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 4
videos.overview: Jacqui Oatley presents highlights of the day's Euro 2016 action as the Republic of Ireland face Sweden, Spain take on the Czech Republic and Belgium play against Italy.

videos.title: 14th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 5
videos.overview: Jacqui Oatley, Manu Petit, Norman Whiteside and Eni Aluko round-up the day's action, including Austria v Hungary and Portugal v Iceland.

videos.title: 15th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 6
videos.overview: Highlights of the day's two group games, in which host nation France took on Albania in Marseille and Russia played Slovakia. France have won all four European Championship meetings against Albania, albeit in qualifying matches, but Albania were victorious in the last encounter, a friendly in 2015. Russia's game with Slovakia could be important for fellow Group B members England and Wales.

videos.title: 16th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 7
videos.overview: Highlights of all three group matches on a busy day of Euro 2016 action. The all-British clash between England and Wales took centre stage as both countries looked to not only secure precious group B points but also bragging rights. Northern Ireland were another of the sides in action; they took on Ukraine in Lyon. Michael O'Neill's side impressed in qualifying to secure their first ever place at a European championship. Northern Ireland's other group rivals Germany and Poland met at the Stade de France in Paris. The two neighbours met in qualification, with Poland securing their first win over the world champions. Polish hotshot Robert Lewandowski plays his football with German giants Bayern Munich and will be one of several global stars on display.

videos.title: 17th June 2016: Euro 2016 Day 8
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces the best of the action from the day's three group matches, including defending champions Spain against Turkey. Spain are seeking an unprecedented third successive European title and, despite their early exit from the last World Cup, remain among the favourites in France. There are also highlights from the other Group D game between Czech Republic and Croatia and the Group E clash between Sweden and 2012 runners-up Italy.
